📋 The Key Points

Calesthetics is free with one training plan. Premium unlocks every plan and every exercise: $9.99 per month (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or $49.99 per year. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in your Apple or Google subscription settings. Train within your own limits: this app is training guidance, not medical advice.

These Terms of Service (also called Terms of Use) are an agreement between you and Verado Studio ("we", "us") for the Calesthetics app. By installing or using the app you agree to them and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

The app is for adults. You must be 18 or older, or the age of majority where you live.

2. Health, Safety & Not Medical Advice

⚠️ Train Within Your Own Limits

Calesthetics provides general training guidance. It is not medical advice and not a substitute for a doctor or qualified coach. Talk to a doctor before you start if you have an injury, a health condition, or are pregnant. Stop right away if you feel pain, dizziness or anything unusual. You use the app and do the exercises at your own risk. The "areas to protect" you choose only change which exercises are suggested; they are not a medical assessment, and no plan can promise a result.

3. Your Account

  • Optional: You can use the app as a guest. An account (email, Google or Apple) saves your plan and progress so they follow you to a new phone.
  • Keep it safe: You are responsible for your sign-in details and for what happens under your account. Give us accurate information and tell us if you think someone else is using your account.
  • Delete it anytime: In the app, go to Profile > Delete Account. This erases your account and its data (see our Privacy Policy). As a guest, Profile > Erase data on this phone clears what is saved on your phone.

4. Free and Premium

  • Free: One training plan, and the exercise videos in that plan.
  • Premium: Every plan, and every exercise and video in Discover. Premium may include other features we add later.
  • We may change, add or remove features, and the line between Free and Premium, as the app develops. We will not take away what you have already paid for during the period you paid for.

5. Subscriptions, Free Trial & Billing

A. Prices and Free Trial

  • Monthly: $9.99 per month, with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Yearly: $49.99 per year (no trial).
  • Prices can differ by country and include taxes where required; the exact price is shown in the store before you confirm. The free trial is offered once per person. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

B. Billing and Renewal

  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID or Google Play account when you confirm the purchase (or when the free trial ends).
  • Subscriptions renew automatically for the same period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before it ends.

C. Cancelling, Refunds and Restoring

  • Manage or cancel in your Apple ID > Subscriptions or Google Play > Payments & subscriptions settings. Deleting the app or your Calesthetics account does not cancel a subscription.
  • Apple and Google handle payments and refunds, and their rules apply. We cannot refund purchases made through them.
  • On a new phone, use Restore on the Premium screen to bring your subscription back.
